tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Read your signed-in identity, default team and granted API scopes.

tools.name: episodes_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete an episode. Requires its team owner. Returns a durable run ID; check episodes_deletion_status for completion.

tools.name: episodes_deletion_status
tools.description: Read current durable episode deletion progress or its terminal result without waiting for completion.

tools.name: episodes_list
tools.description: List a bounded page of podcast episodes and their publication and processing state. Continue with next_cursor.

tools.name: episodes_order_get
tools.description: Read published episode IDs in feed order.

tools.name: episodes_order_set
tools.description: Move supplied published episodes to the front in order. Other episodes retain their relative order. Publication dates and media are preserved.

tools.name: episodes_upload_link
tools.description: Return the podcast's existing dashboard episode upload page. Ask the person to open it and choose their media. Gigabyte uploads happen in their browser, never through MCP. Use episodes_list afterward to inspect the episode.

tools.name: imports_rss_start
tools.description: Start an RSS import in the default team shown by auth_status. Returns a durable run ID; use imports_rss_status. Media imports continue in the background.

tools.name: imports_rss_status
tools.description: Read current RSS import progress or its terminal result without waiting for completion.

tools.name: show_invitations_remove
tools.description: Revoke a pending podcast invitation. Requires team owner access.

tools.name: show_invitations_set_role
tools.description: Change a pending podcast invitation's role. Requires team owner access.

tools.name: show_members_invite
tools.description: Invite a person to collaborate on a podcast. Sends an email and requires team owner access.

tools.name: show_members_list
tools.description: List podcast collaborators and pending invitations.

tools.name: show_members_remove
tools.description: Remove a podcast collaborator. Requires team owner access.

tools.name: show_members_set_role
tools.description: Change a podcast collaborator's role. Requires team owner access.

tools.name: shows_create
tools.description: Create an audio or video podcast in a writable team. The server allocates its ID. Upload media through the dashboard; use the local CLI for YouTube imports.

tools.name: shows_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a podcast and its episodes. Requires its owner. Returns a durable run ID; check shows_deletion_status for completion.

tools.name: shows_deletion_status
tools.description: Read the current durable podcast deletion progress or terminal result without waiting for completion.

tools.name: shows_list
tools.description: List accessible podcasts with IDs, slugs and team IDs. Continue with next_offset.

tools.name: shows_update
tools.description: Update supplied podcast fields. Omitted fields are preserved. Existing permissions apply.

tools.name: team_invitations_remove
tools.description: Revoke a pending default-team invitation. Requires team owner access.

tools.name: team_invitations_set_role
tools.description: Change a pending default-team invitation's role. Requires team owner access.

tools.name: team_members_invite
tools.description: Invite a person to the default team by email. Sends an email and requires team owner access.

tools.name: team_members_list
tools.description: List members and pending invitations in the default team shown by auth_status.

tools.name: team_members_remove
tools.description: Remove a member from the default team. Requires team owner access.

tools.name: team_members_set_role
tools.description: Change a default-team member's role. Requires team owner access.

tools.name: teams_list
tools.description: List accessible teams. Use a writable team ID to create a podcast. Continue with next_offset.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: episodes_order_get, imports_rss_status · Public sink: episodes_upload_link, show_members_invite, shows_create, team_members_invite · Destructive: episodes_delete, imports_rss_start, show_invitations_remove, show_members_remove, shows_delete, team_invitations_remove, team_members_remove.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: episodes_order_get, imports_rss_status · Public sink: episodes_upload_link, show_members_invite, shows_create, team_members_invite · Destructive: episodes_delete, imports_rss_start, show_invitations_remove, show_members_remove, shows_delete, team_invitations_remove, team_members_remove

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
